text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Bamboo Memory's strong request, we had 
a meal at a ramen shop famous for its 
spice.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwooooh! S-Shpicy...! My mouf is shtill 
tingling...!
choice_data_list:
I-It hurts so much every time I 
breathe...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I unnerstand, sir...! It's like, 
swallering a shuriken whole, kinda 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But... thizh is proof of a fiehse 
battle...! I wanna fight you again 
shometime...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, we both quenched our thirst 
with some cold water, when suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... it's so spicy...! 
But... it'd be bad to leave it 
unfinished... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! If you don't mind, I can eat 
that ramen for ya!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Eh!? Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking I'd love a rematch, 
yeah! Besides... if someone's calling for 
help, answering is just common sense!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, um! If possible, please take mine 
too! —I haven't touched it with my 
chopsticks yet, so, um...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! For the sake of the shop... 
this fiery Disciplinary Committee Chair 
will lend a hand!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a cry for help fired up Bamboo 
Memory, but... it looks like we're going 
to have to eat a massive amount of ramen!
choice_data_list:
Go for it, Discipline Committee 
Chairwoman!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a cry for help fired up Bamboo 
Memory, but... it looks like we're going 
to have to eat a massive amount of ramen!
choice_data_list:
Go for it, Discipline Committee 
Chairwoman!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer... Even though you were having 
such a hard time...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I support that spirit of yours! But if 
it ever gets too much to handle, you've 
gotta tag me in, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Goooooo for it! Trainer!! If you want 
seconds, I've already got 'em right here!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Her chopsticks haven't stopped...! Such 
incredible guts...! —Maybe I should give 
it another shot too...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The Trainer's passion is touching 
everyone's hearts...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the people who had given up 
once began trying again, so Bamboo Memory 
didn't have to eat any additional bowls of 
ramen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh! Overtime for this fiery battle 
with spicy ramen... Here I gooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*Puh-hah*!!! Th-Thanks... for... the 
match...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having polished off the bowl down to the 
last drop... the shop erupted into 
thunderous applause!!
